author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for Choppa: Rescue Rivals, a 2D helicopter side-scrolling action game developed by Parta Games Oy. Players will embark on high-octane, action-packed levels to outmaneuver enemies and save lives in the process. Overcome challenges and become an ace pilot in Choppa: Rescue Rivals, available now for Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam).
title: Choppa: Rescue Rivals - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for NEVERFED, a story-driven incremental action game developed by Lumamind Studio. Players will escape an experimental lab as an inexplicable organism. Consume other organisms, destroy anything along the way, and become an unstoppable force. NEVERFED is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: NEVERFED - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Off Axis, a sci-fi action first-person shooter developed by Off Axis. Players will explore a massive spaceship after being cut off from the evacuation route. Manipulate gravity to gain the upper hand, use an array of weapons, and seek the truth behind the ship's main function. Off Axis is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Off Axis - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Dumb Ways to Build, a chaotic physics-based co-op game developed by Dumb Ways to Die. Players will work together to take on chaotic and life-threatening jobs across a vibrant city. Pay no mind to safety violations, utilize a variety of tools, and assemble sketchy structures for the public to enjoy. Dumb Ways to Build is launching on September 10 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Dumb Ways to Build - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Launch Trailer for How to Fish, a co-op physics-based fishing simulator developed by Dazed Games. Players will find themselves stranded on an island with the desire to work in order to return home. Complete quests, learn how to fish, and make use of new equipment to add a special flair to the fishing endeavors. How to Fish is available now on PC (Steam).
title: How to Fish - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Announcement Trailer for Finals Week, a first-person co-op cheating simulation game developed by Studio Cimosa. Players will do whatever it takes to survive the last week of school with friends in co-op. Steal the answers to the exam, share information with friends, and graduate by any means necessary. Finals Week is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Finals Week - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the gamescom 2026 Teaser Trailer for ORMOD: Directive, a first-person survival action shooter developed by House 16 Software. Players will scavenge, fight, and survive across a struggling world after ORMOD has taken over. Engage in PvP, PvE, Hardcore, Creative, and mini-game modes in ORMOD: Directive, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: ORMOD: Directive - Official gamescom 2026 Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Wildmagic Frontier trailer for this upcoming character-driven, deck-building tactics RPG. Across the adventure, Players will recruit a colorful cast of Companions, craft cards, build decks around clever combos, and take on tactical battles across detailed real-world dioramas created through physical and 3D sculpting. Adventures can be played solo or cooperatively with up to two friends, with players returning from expeditions to grow their frontier town and unlock new characters, mechanics, and quests. A Kickstarter campaign for Wildmagic Frontier is coming soon.
title: Wildmagic Frontier - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
A lost legend is getting ready to rise from the ashes! Watch the Terranigma trailer for a peek at the world and story of this action RPG, as this classic from 1995 returns and will be available to play on modern consoles. Terranigma will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and GOG) in 2027.

The Earth is a hollow sphere with two sides: an external Lightside and an internal Darkside. In the Darkside village of Crysta, the mischievous Ark lives unaware of the world beyond. But one day, he opens a forbidden door and sets in motion events that will change the world.
title: Terranigma - Official Rebirth Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Knuckle Jet, an arcade side-scrolling platformer developed by Rain Games. Players will explore stylized levels with a suite of mechanics and gameplay features. Explore the environment, attain upgrades, and seek out collectibles in Knuckle Jet, launching on September 1 for PC (Steam).
title: Knuckle Jet - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Console Performance Mode Gameplay for The Blood of Dawnwalker, an upcoming third-person action RPG developed by Rebel Wolves. Players can check out an updated look at the game's Performance Mode, offering the game in 60 FPS on console, alongside the previously announced Quality and Balanced modes for a more visually-driven presentation. Take on enemies by day and become a vampire by night in The Blood of Dawnwalker, launching on September 3 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).
title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - Official Console Performance Mode Gameplay

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the White Clouds announcement trailer for this upcoming cozy mountain meditation game. In White Clouds, an old house is waiting for someone to come back. You tend to repair old furniture, clean lakes, plant flowers, brew tea, and write haiku about what you see. Travellers climb up to visit. Find your peace above the clouds. White Clouds will be available on PC.
title: White Clouds - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Trust Your Gut, a strategy roguelite roulette game developed by Mishleto. Players will lay the fate of their lives on chance by placing bets, spinning the wheel, and praying for a living outcome. Engage with five-ball roulette, 150+ rule-bending mementos, and 50 ball variants for a variety of different outcomes from game to game. Trust Your Gut is launching on November 19 for PC (Steam).
title: Trust Your Gut - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Release Date Trailer for Animal Falling, a 3D chaotic multiplayer platformer developed by WOUAFL. Players will sabotage other players by setting traps and causing devastating falls from grace, all in the name of victory. Animal Falling is launching on August 27 for PC (Steam).
title: Animal Falling - Official Gameplay Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Publishing Announcement Trailer for Clutch, an upcoming narrative-driven open-world racing game developed by Maverick Games. Players will race across the French Riviera with the world's fastest cars and legendary professional drivers alike. Enjoy the announcement of Focus Entertainment being the publisher for Clutch, launching in Spring 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Clutch - Official Publishing Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Reveal Trailer for The Count is Down for Blood, a strategy-based puzzle game developed by Righteous Tree. Players will take on gothic grid-based puzzles where every move calls the sun to draw ever closer as the match progresses. Avoid persistent hunters, drink blood, and make it to the coffin before the countdown depletes. The Count is Down for Blood is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Count is Down for Blood - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Silent Breath leaves early access and the full release is out now on PC. Face the forest. Uncover the truth. Break the cycle. Check out the Silent Breath full release trailer for this horror game for another look at the nightmares that await you. 

Unpredictable horrors lurk around every corner, forcing you to find the missing people while desperately clinging to survival. In this experience, even your own mind can become your enemy. Stay vigilant and keep your voice hushed, or risk becoming another victim of the forest's darkness.
title: Silent Breath - Official Full Release Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for Exit Ways, a PvEvP survival extraction shooter game. Grow your community in a zombie apocalypse. Rescue survivors, craft gear and build a base. Exit Ways is available now in Steam Early Access.
title: Exit Ways - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Voice Cast Reveal Trailer for Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse, an upcoming 2D action-adventure Metroidvania RPG developed by Evil Empire and Konami. Players can meet the English Voice Cast with Abby Trott as the game’s protagonist, Rose Belmont, and Graham McTavish as the iconic Dracula. Meet more of the game's cast in Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse, launching on October 15 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Xbox on PC and Steam).
title: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse - Official Voice Cast Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Collector's Edition Trailer for Metro 2039, the next installment in the first-person action horror shooter developed by 4A Games. Players can check out the game's Collector's Edition, fitted with a beautifully crafted replica of the mysterious Stranger’s battle-scarred helmet. Pre-orders are coming soon for the Collector's Edition of Metro 2039, launching in February 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Metro 2039 - Official Collector's Edition Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the gamescom Demo Teaser Trailer for Cronos: Lazarus, an upcoming DLC to the hit third-person horror action shooter developed by Bloober Team. Players will engage in a faster combat style with the Warden on an elusive mission that not even the Collective can know. Go hands-on with Cronos: Lazarus at gamescom, with the DLC launching soon for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam, GoG, and Epic Games Store).
title: Cronos: Lazarus - Official gamescom Demo Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 Trailer for Forza Horizon 6, the latest addition to the hit racing simulation franchise developed by Playground Games. Players can now gain access to American muscle with the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 speeding into Horizon Festival. Get behind the wheel of the Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 in Forza Horizon 6, available now for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam), with an eventual release on PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Forza Horizon 6 - Official Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Cult of the Lamb Gameplay Showcase Trailer for Two Point Museum, a museum management simulation game developed by Two Point Studios. Players can now access new content in the game based on the hit cult management game Cult of the Lamb. Explore new exhibits, items, gameplay mechanics, and more. The Cult of the Lamb collaboration with Two Point Museum is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Studio).
title: Two Point Museum x Cult of the Lamb - Official Gameplay Showcase Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the 'Echoes of the Past' Trailer for Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio. Players will progress through a riveting narrative while running from the dark elements of the past that still haunt Sophia. Make amends with the dreams and visions in Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, launching on August 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Official 'Echoes of the Past' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Ling’s Legendary Weapon Trailer for Shadow Fight 4: Arena, an action 2D fighting game developed by Nekki Limited. Players can become acquainted with the new legendary weapon for Ling, the Blade of the Primordials. Look out for the different forms of the Blades with the Primordial of Fire, Primordial of Crystal, and more. Ling’s Legendary Weapon is available now in Shadow Fight 4: Arena on iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Shadow Fight 4: Arena - Official Ling’s Legendary Weapon Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Rover Operator Trailer for Delta Force, the hit free-to-play action shooter developed by Team Jade. Players can get a look at the new upcoming operator Rowan Walsh, codename Rover, and Clover, his four-legged best friend, joining the battlefield. Become a valuable Support class with Clover being able to search out nearby enemies and Rover's Dart Rifle to gain the upper hand. Rover is launching soon into Delta Force for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Delta Force - Official Rover Operator Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Locus Equation is a psychological RPG that turns decision-making itself into the game—a safe sandbox for players to choose and live with what their choices reveal about them. Set in a universe where artificial intelligence and the human soul collide, Locus Equation asks: How do you truly know yourself before something else does it—and everything else—for you? Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243310/Locus_Equation/
title: Locus Equation: Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Skygate Zero in this trailer for the upcoming skateboarding 3D platformer adventure game. In Skygate Zero, you’ll explore the flooded future on your customizable Glideboard. Ride, trick, wallride and grind the wasteland, smash enemies, grab Shards, and tune your setup as you reconnect the Skyways and find your line to the impossible. Skygate Zero will be available on PC.
title: Skygate Zero - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 'Four Classes, One Mission' Trailer for DarkSwarm, a top-down co-op action shooter developed by Bitfire Games. Players can get the general rundown from key members of the development team on enduring the procedurally generated levels filled with a growing infestation. Make use of distinct classes, tools, and more to take out the swarm in DarkSwarm, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: DarkSwarm - Official 'Four Classes, One Mission' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the 'UNCUT Action' Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer for Stellar Blade: Complete Edition, the hit third-person action game developed by SHIFT UP. Players will take on the role of EVE in a thrilling fight to save Earth through intense melee-combat engagements, the exploration of ruins across the world, and dangerous enemies to dispatch. Make use of Nintendo Switch-specific features like Joy-Con 2 motion controls in Stellar Blade: Complete Edition, coming soon to Nintendo Switch 2, alongside the game being available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Stellar Blade: Complete Edition - Official 'UNCUT Action' Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this sizzle reel of footage from games only on PlayStation 5. See glimpses of Wolverine, God of War Laufey, Saros, Gran Turismo 7 and Astro Bot! 
Marvel's Wolverine launches on September 15th 2026, and God of War Laufey launches February 16th 2027.
title: PlayStation 5 - Official "Only on PS5" Video

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Update Trailer for Cosmos Point, a turn-based tactics extraction shooter developed by Anatoliy Sidorov. Players can now access brand-new content in the game with a new Region to fight through, filled with tough enemies to dispatch. The latest update for Cosmos Point is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Cosmos Point - Official Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Sunken Realms, a third-person action RPG developed by Magic Puncher Games. Players will take on the trials and tribulations of the underground city of Aedaria that has fallen to the darkness. Craft powerful weapons, master forgotten magic, and find your father in Sunken Realms, launching on September 18 for PC (Steam).
title: Sunken Realms - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Hunt: Showdown 1896 is headed to gamescom. Stay tuned to IGN on August 26 for a major announcement about the first-person PvP bounty hunting game.
title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Exclusive Teaser
